look_here_first: Rounded lobes, light gray scaly bark, shallow unfringed acorn cups.

best_field_traits: Five to seven rounded bristleless leaf lobes

comparisons.key_distinctions: Bur oak has fringed cups and a deep midleaf waist; post oak has cross-shaped leaves; chinkapin oak has toothed leaves.
